tools.name: listCustomers
tools.description: List MSMEs; filter by health status, region, sector, RM or name.

tools.name: getCustomer360
tools.description: Everything about a customer in one call (loans, health, signals, open work).

tools.name: getMonthlyCashflow
tools.description: Monthly inflow / outflow / receipts / repayments summary.

tools.name: getTaxFilings
tools.description: BIR quarterly VAT (2550Q) / percentage tax (2551Q) and annual ITR (1701/1702).

tools.name: getLoans
tools.description: Loans with repayment schedule and utilisation.

tools.name: getPortfolioSummary
tools.description: Exposure, health mix, regions, sectors, queues.

tools.name: runPortfolioMonitoring
tools.description: Recalculate signals for every active borrower; returns who needs attention (daily workflow).

tools.name: getEarlyWarningSignals
tools.description: Current metrics and fired signals for one customer (nothing stored).

tools.name: calculateEarlyWarningSignals
tools.description: Recalculate, store a snapshot and update health status (emits HEALTH_STATUS_CHANGED).

tools.name: createRiskAlert
tools.description: Raise an early-warning alert with evidence and a recommended human action.

tools.name: createRMTask
tools.description: Create a task for the customer's RM (risk outreach, document follow-up, growth).

tools.name: getReferenceData
tools.description: Products, early-warning rules, document checklist, RMs, event types.
